entrance.name: museum admission (required for each night camped)

values.note: Camping: $20 a night no electricity, $30 20-amp, $35 30-amp, $50 50-amp. On top of that every guest must buy museum admission for each night stayed, for those exact dates: adults/seniors $20 ($25 on car-show days), youth 11-17 $12 ($15), children 10 and under free, veterans $18 and active military free (ID, sold on site). Two adults in a non-electric site pay $60 a night all in.

fees.source: https://gilmorecarmuseum.org/visit/on-site-camping/ ('Camping Fees $20/night no electricity $30/night 20 amp $35/night 30 amp $50/night 50 amp'; 'Guests are required to purchase admission based on the number of nights stayed. Tickets must be purchased for the exact dates you will be visiting the museum. Show day pricing may apply.') + https://gilmorecarmuseum.org/visit/hours-admission/ (General Admission and Day of Car Show rates), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Rustic camping on a grass field: 2 50-amp, 4 30-amp and 8 20-amp sites, the rest non-electric; each site space is 20 ft x 60 ft. No grey or black water discharge, no ground fires or tarps.

sites.source: https://gilmorecarmuseum.org/visit/on-site-camping/ ('100 campsites include ...'; 'Site space is 20ft x 60ft'; camping rules), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Public restrooms (no showers) at the museum's Shell Station.

facilities.source: https://gilmorecarmuseum.org/visit/on-site-camping/ ('Public restrooms (no showers) are available at the Shell Station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book a site online on the museum's camping page (by site type), then register at the Museum Store on arrival. Check-in 12-5 pm (must arrive before 5), check-out 9-11:30 am. No camper may enter or leave the gate while a car show is running. Full refund only for cancellations e-mailed 14 days ahead. During the Red Barns Spectacular (Aug 1, 2026) only vintage campers (2001 and earlier) are allowed.

note: Rustic camping on a level mowed grass field on the Gilmore Car Museum grounds (a nonprofit museum), open to the public for general overnight camping through the season, not event-only. Car-show campers are asked to arrive the day before the show and stay through. --Claude
summary: Museum's camping page (2026): general camping Apr 1 - Oct 31, 100 sites (2 x 50 A, 4 x 30 A, 8 x 20 A, rest non-electric), no water/sewer, restrooms without showers, $20-50 a night plus museum admission for every guest for every night ($20 adult, $25 on show days); booked online; phone (269) 671-5089 matches. Confirmed the derived count/hookups/season/showers; added the admission as a per-person-day entrance, booking rules, site size. Note cleaned of the site/hookup/price/booking text the fields hold.
flags: Price gate (mandatory per-night fee): every guest must buy museum admission for each night camped ('Guests are required to purchase admission based on the number of nights stayed'), $20 per adult ($25 on car-show days). A 23-ft motorhome with two adults on the cheapest (non-electric) site pays $20 + 2 x $20 = $60 a night, over US$50 (one adult: $40). No gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 62 km); the family has not stayed here.

Event check passes: camping is general overnight camping open to the public April 1 - October 31 with online booking by site type, not event-only; car shows only restrict gate access during show hours, and the Red Barns Spectacular (Aug 1, 2026) admits vintage campers only.
